input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there

doc_friction.issue: Step 0's open list held 12 entries, 11 of them control-plane fixes waiting on owner approval; re-checking each by grep is the only step-0 work an ordinary run can do, which the prompt does not say.

deviations.why: Step 0 says fix open defects first; all 12 remain control plane (owner approval) or a deliberately deferred eval (help-keeper stem).
deviations.did: Confirmed each still reproduces on main by grepping the named workflow/tool for the fix, left them open, and moved on to seeding.
deviations.result: Run time went to the new udf-ranges code instead, where it found a real bug.

notes: Targets: ventures/xer-schedule-check/udf-ranges.mjs (new on main 2026-11-19) and risk.mjs, 10 mutants each. 16/20 caught before, 20/20 after rerun. Real defect fixed at the single consumer (riskAnalysis override check), so every range source (CSV, UDF, future ones) is guarded: the class fix for step 4. No new CI guard: the venture suite already runs in ventures-tests.yml. Verification: run_venture_tests.py xer-schedule-check: 106 tests, 0 failed.

real_defects.issue: Ranges read from the file's own P6 UDFs (udf-ranges.mjs) reached riskAnalysis with only an order check, so negative points were drawn as negative work: an activity with -20/-10/-5 day UDFs pulled the simulated P10-P90 finish to 1 working day against a 6-day CPM finish, with no warning. parseRanges (the CSV path) already rejected min < 0. Fix: the override check also needs a >= 0; such ranges fall back to the default range and the warning now says a point is negative or out of order. Failing-first test in udf-ranges.test.mjs.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: seeding and triaging 20 mutants, reproducing and fixing one bug, 5 tests, a post

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
